description: This file defines an abstract base class 'BitsStreamGenerator' for random number generators that generate bit streams. It includes core methods for generating various primitive random outputs and manages internal state for Gaussian number generation.

classes.name: BitsStreamGenerator
classes.description: Abstract class providing a base implementation for bit stream-based random number generators, supporting seed setting, core bit generation, and various primitive distributions.

methods.name: setSeed
methods.description: Abstract method to set the seed using an int, int array, or long, to initialize the generator.

methods.name: next
methods.description: Abstract method generating a specified number of random bits.

methods.name: nextBytes
methods.description: Fills a byte array with random bytes.

methods.name: nextDouble
methods.description: Generates a random double between 0.0 and 1.0.

methods.name: nextFloat
methods.description: Generates a random float between 0.0 and 1.0.

methods.name: nextGaussian
methods.description: Generates a Gaussian-distributed random number, using the Box-Muller transform with caching.

methods.name: nextInt
methods.description: Generates a uniformly distributed int between 0 (inclusive) and n (exclusive).

methods.name: nextLong
methods.description: Generates a random long between 0 (inclusive) and n (exclusive).

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Resets internal state used for Gaussian number caching.
